definitions.explanation: An item or offer that provides good value for the price.

examples.japanese: これはお{買|か}い{得|どく}だ。
お{買|か}い{得|どく}{品|ひん}を{探|さが}す。
{三|みっ}つ{買|か}うと{一|ひと}つ{無料|むりょう}でお{買|か}い{得|どく}です。
examples.english: Buy three get one free is a good deal.

notes:
お{買|か}い{得|どく} describes something that offers good value for the money. The お prefix adds politeness and appeal. Can function as both a noun and a na-adjective.

FORMS:
- お{買|か}い{得|どく}な{商品|しょうひん}: a bargain product (na-adjective)
- お{買|か}い{得|どく}だ / お{買|か}い{得|どく}です: is a good deal

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{買|か}い{得|どく}{品|ひん}: bargain item
- お{買|か}い{得|どく}{価格|かかく}: bargain price
- お{買|か}い{得|どく}セット: value set/combo
- お{買|か}い{得|どく}{情報|じょうほう}: deals/bargain info

REGISTER:
Frequently used in advertising, store signs, and online shopping. The polite お makes it sound inviting to customers.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {割引|わりびき}: discount (specific price reduction)
- セール: sale (event)
- {特売|とくばい}: special sale (often in supermarkets)
- {格安|かくやす}: extremely cheap
